latents.fact: a {ADJ} personal effect lies in the middle of the promenade — too valuable to abandon casually, too specific to be an accident
latents.item_desc: A {ADJ} object, dropped and left behind. The crowd moved on without it.

latents.fact: the noise of the crowd has not faded — it is not an echo, it is still happening

latents.exit_desc: The service gate opens into passages beyond the perimeter.
